name: 수강생

tips.단·복수: many, there are 뒤에는 복수형(-s). clothes는 항상 복수예요.
tips.주어-동사: he/she/it/my hometown → has, is. 동사는 하나만!
tips.동사·시제: 과거 질문엔 끝까지 과거형. agree는 동사라 be동사 없이.
tips.문장 구조: 한 문장에 동사는 하나! 나한테 어렵다는 It's difficult for me to.
tips.관사·전치사: good at, listen to, on the bus, in the evening.
tips.단어 선택: tell + 사람, look forward to + -ing, be used to + -ing.

focus.3: 과거 이야기는 끝까지 과거형! 이유를 말할 땐 On top of that으로 하나 더.

compare: I'm interested in music. (내 관심) · Music is interesting. (대상)
I used to + 동사원형 (예전엔 ~했다) · I'm used to + -ing (~에 익숙하다)

cards.en: There are many good restaurants in my area.
cards.gram:
여러 개면 there are + 복수명사. many 뒤에는 -s: restaurants.
there is vs there are · 하나면 there is a restaurant, 여러 개면 there are many restaurants.
cards.mine: There is many good restaurant in my area.

cards.en: My hometown has a lot of parks.
cards.gram: 주어가 my hometown(하나)이라 has. he/she/it에는 has!
cards.mine: My hometown have a lot of park.

cards.en: I agree with that opinion.
cards.gram: agree는 동사라 be동사가 필요 없어요. I'm agree ❌ → I agree.

cards.en: I went to Jeju last summer.
cards.gram: last summer가 있으면 과거형 went. 과거 이야기는 끝까지 과거형으로!
cards.mine: I go to Jeju last summer.

cards.en: It makes me feel relaxed.
cards.gram:
한 문장에 동사는 하나! is + make ❌ → It makes me feel relaxed.
make + 사람 + 동사원형 · It makes me feel happy.
cards.mine: It is make me feel relax.

cards.en: I'm interested in music.
cards.gram:
내 기분·관심은 interested, 대상이 재밌으면 interesting.
interested vs interesting · I'm interested in music. / Music is interesting.

cards.en: I'm good at cooking.
cards.gram: 잘한다는 good at + 명사·-ing. good in ❌

cards.en: I usually go to the gym in the evening.
cards.gram: 저녁·아침은 in the evening, 헬스장은 the gym. at evening ❌
cards.mine: I usually go to gym at evening.

cards.en: I'm really looking forward to my next trip.
cards.gram: look forward to의 to는 전치사라 뒤에 명사나 -ing가 와요: looking forward to seeing you.
cards.mine: I'm really looking forward to go my next trip.

cards.en: I've lived in Seoul for five years.
cards.gram: 과거부터 지금까지 계속이면 현재완료 have lived + for 기간.
cards.mine: I live in Seoul for five years.

cards.en: I'm used to getting up early.
cards.gram:
be used to + -ing = ~에 익숙하다.
used to vs be used to · I used to get up early. (예전엔 그랬다) / I'm used to getting up early. (지금 익숙하다)
cards.mine: I used to get up early.

cards.en: It's difficult for me to speak English.
cards.gram: '나한테 어렵다'는 It's difficult for me to + 동사. difficult to me ❌
cards.mine: Speaking English is difficult to me.

cards.en: Let me tell you about my family.
cards.gram: 사람에게 말해 줄 땐 tell + 사람. say는 사람이 바로 못 와요: say you ❌
cards.mine: I'll say you about my family.

cards.en: The movie was boring.
cards.gram: 대상이 지루하면 boring, 내가 지루하면 bored: I was bored.

cards.en: I bought some new clothes.
cards.gram: clothes는 늘 복수라 a를 못 붙여요. '좀'은 some.

cards.en: I listen to music on the bus.
cards.gram: listen to + 들을 것. 버스·지하철 안은 on the bus.
cards.mine: I listen music in the bus.

cards.ko: 솔직히 말하면, 저는 아침형 인간이 아니에요.
cards.en: To be honest, I'm not a morning person.
cards.gram: To be honest = 솔직히 말하면. 답변 첫마디로 자연스러워요.

cards.en: It depends on the situation.
cards.gram: It depends on + 명사 = ~에 따라 달라요. Part 3 첫마디로 딱이에요.

cards.en: That's a tricky question, but I'd say cooking.
cards.gram: 생각할 시간이 필요할 때: That's a tricky question, but I'd say …

cards.en: I'm really into yoga these days.
cards.gram: be into + 명사 = ~에 빠져 있다. like보다 자연스러워요.

cards.en: It's not really my cup of tea.
cards.gram: not my cup of tea = 내 취향이 아니다.

cards.en: On top of that, it's really cheap.
cards.gram: On top of that = 게다가. 이유를 하나 더 붙일 때.

cards.en: I can't be bothered to cook after work.
cards.gram: I can't be bothered to + 동사 = ~하기 귀찮다.

cards.en: It's a 10-minute walk from my house.
cards.gram: 거리를 시간으로: It's a 10-minute walk. minute은 단수로 붙여 써요.
